newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove to announce Alliance result Monday.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove to announce Alliance result Monday.

text.p: Stockbroker Cazenove & Co said on Friday it will announce the result of the first auction of shares in Alliance & Leicester Plc, which takes place between 1530 and 1730 GMT today, after the shares are listed on the stock exchange next Monday.
Cazenove will auction some 157 million shares representing around 27 percent of the former building society's share capital.
The shares consist of free shares allocated to members of the society during its flotation which they have decided to sell through a free dealing service set up by Alliance.
Cazenove said the result of the first auction, and the number of share to be sold in the second auction will be announced shortly after the market opens on Monday.
The announcement will include the number of shares that have been sold at each price.
